title: 第450章 夜魇的机缘到了第449章 小云云的首富计划
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
lines: “高阶帝器就只有这么点作用？”
这一点，秦然很不解。
五域吞魔罐的名字很响，而且看小云云的表情，这东西定然不凡，若只能当监狱使用的话，显然有损高阶帝器的名头。
女人缓缓摇头，“你没见过全盛期的顶级神魔有多恐怖，同阶大帝与其抗衡不了十招，它们抬手间便可移山填海，挪移星辰，困住它们的难度远比你想象中要高得多。”
“人族大帝想要抗衡顶级神魔，大多只能采用围杀策略，很多时候虽然战胜了，却无法将它们直接抹杀，更不可能打赢后将它们直接放了。”
“久而久之，人族大帝们就想出了将顶级神魔困死的策略，让岁月将顶级神魔一点点消磨死。”
“但，普通监狱又无法彻底囚禁它们，过往发生过很多顶级神魔破封而出，屠杀人族的事件。”
“所以，五域吞魔罐便出现了……”
秦然的眉头皱了起来。
这神魔族的实力，似乎比他原著中设定的还要夸张。
小云云继续道：“五域吞魔罐是玄黄大道盟花费了无尽资源和时间打造，作用确实单一，但其内部小世界的稳固程度，以及五域吞魔罐自身的坚硬度，都达到了匪夷所思的地步，即便顶级神魔也无法破开！”
“只是不知，为何会沦落为碎片。”
“若是可以……”小云云顿了顿，“若是可以的话，将其修复回来，未来定能起到大用处。”
秦然陷入了沉默。
片刻后，他将残片从挂鼎中取出。
小云云见状，眸光略有几分黯淡，却也没再说什么。
然而下一秒，秦然却做出了一个让她傻眼的举动——
大夏龙雀跃然出现。
秦然手握暗金色长剑，对准残片的中间，一剑又一剑地狠狠斩了下去。
叮！叮！叮！叮！！！
一时间，修炼室内回荡着清脆的金铁交鸣声，伴随着一阵闪瞎眼的火花……
“你！你在做什么？”小云云懵懵的。
秦然沉着脸，硬扛着那恐怖的反震力，“这东西我自己需要一个！未来如果神魔族入侵，人族有需要的话，可以将另一半也复原，当做神魔监狱使用。”
小云云的眼睛亮了。
看向秦然的眼神中多了些不一样的东西。
五域吞魔罐的坚硬程度，比小云云形容的只强不弱，秦然用剑尖足足斩了一个多时辰，才勉强将这残破碎片劈成了两半。
大夏龙雀的器灵，传出了一股极度不悦的情绪……
“行了，等朕以后有了大钱，一定强化你！”
器灵对这大饼并不买单。
秦然收起半块碎片，将另外半块扔进了挂鼎当中。
【检测到可修复物品——五域吞魔罐（高阶帝器），是否花费1010000灵晶髓进行修复？】
涨价了！！
content_en:
"Is the high-level imperial weapon only useful for so much?"
Kieran was puzzled by this.
The name of the Five Domains Demon Swallowing Jar is very loud, and judging from Xiao Yunyun's expression, this thing must be extraordinary. If it can only be used as a prison, it will obviously damage the reputation of a high-level imperial weapon.
The woman slowly shook her head, "You have never seen how terrifying the top gods and demons are in their heyday. The emperors of the same level cannot compete with them in ten moves. They can move mountains, seas, and stars with just a raise of their hands. The difficulty of trapping them is much higher than you think."
"If the human emperor wants to compete with the top gods and demons, most of them can only use the strategy of encirclement and killing. Many times, although they win, they cannot be directly obliterated, let alone release them directly after winning."
"Over time, the human emperors came up with strategies to trap the top gods and demons to death, and let the years wear away the top gods and demons bit by bit."
"However, ordinary prisons cannot completely imprison them. In the past, many top gods and demons broke out and massacred human beings."
"So, the Five Realms Demon Swallowing Jar appeared..."
Kieran's brows furrowed.
The strength of these gods and demons seems to be even more exaggerated than what was set in his original work.
Xiao Yunyun continued: "The Five-Region Demon-Swallowing Jar was built by the Xuanhuang Dao Alliance with endless resources and time. It has a single function, but the stability of the small world inside it and the hardness of the Five-Region Demon-Swallowing Jar itself have reached an incredible level. Even the top gods and demons cannot break it!"
"I just don't know why it fell into pieces."
"If it is possible..." Xiao Yunyun paused, "If it is possible, repair it and it will be of great use in the future."
Qin Ran fell into silence.
After a while, he took out the fragments from the hanging tripod.
When Xiao Yunyun saw this, his eyes dimmed slightly, but he didn't say anything else.
However, the next second, Qin Ran made a move that dumbfounded her——
Phew——!
The Great Xialong appears happily.
Qin Ran held the dark golden sword in his hand, pointed it at the middle of the fragments, and struck down hard with one sword after another.
bite! bite! bite! bite! ! !
For a moment, the training room echoed with the crisp sound of gold and iron, accompanied by a blinding spark...
"You! What are you doing?" Xiao Yunyun was confused.
Qin Ran had a sullen face, holding on to the terrifying counter-shock force, "I need one of these myself! If the gods and demons invade in the future, if the human race needs it, the other half can be restored and used as a prison for gods and demons."
Xiao Yunyun's eyes lit up.
There was something different in the eyes that looked at Kieran.
The five-region magic-swallowing jar was just as hard as what Xiao Yunyun had described. Qin Ran slashed with the tip of his sword for more than an hour before he managed to split the fragment into two halves.
Daxia Longque's weapon spirit conveyed an extremely unhappy mood...
"Okay, when I get a lot of money in the future, I will definitely strengthen you!"
Phew——! !
Qi Ling doesn't pay for this pie.
Qin Ran collected half of the fragments and threw the other half into the hanging cauldron.
[A repairable item has been detected - the Five Domains Demon-Swallowing Jar (high-level imperial weapon). Do you want to spend 1,010,000 spiritual crystal marrow to repair it? 】
The price has increased! !
